newsitem.title: THAILAND: Jasmine to start Indian phone service next month.
newsitem.headline: Jasmine to start Indian phone service next month.

text.p: Thailand's Jasmine International Plc said on Monday test launches of its GSM cellular mobile phone system in India had proved successful and the service will be available next month.

The company said its subsidiary JT Mobiles Co had already completed installation of equipment in southern Hyderabad and Bangalore cities. Full service will begin in Hyderabad this October and would hopefully start with 50,000 subscribers.
The firm said it expects its service in Bangalore, a hub of Indian industry, to become available shortly afterwards.
